description: Convx Web 1.0.1 — Standalone web repository architecture, complete resolution of 502 Bad Gateway and 0:28 audio loop via YouTube Format 18 AAC-LC streaming, and full HTTP Range seeking support.

changelog.title: Audio Streaming Engine
items: Adoption of YouTube Android client Format 18 (MP4 container with stereo AAC-LC) featuring ratebypass=yes with no PO Token burst limits.
Resolved 502 Bad Gateway and MediaError format errors during track playback.
Fixed the 0:28 audio repeat bug where audio looped back to 00:00 while lyrics and time progressed.
Full HTTP Range support enabling instantaneous seeking to any timestamp.

changelog.title: Standalone Repository Reorganization
items: Complete removal of 1,434 legacy Android files to streamline the codebase.
Promoted web components (frontend, backend, server, Dockerfile) directly to the repository root.
Updated GitHub Actions Docker publishing workflow with multi-stage BuildKit caching.
